about: The fact cards of the game, written by pipeline/igo/facts.py. Every number comes from data/inlets/summary.json and every fact names its source and the day the source was read.

facts.text: The town's map shows 4,439 storm drains.
facts.source: Municipality of Princeton, stormwater inlet layer, snapshot of 2026-09-11

facts.text: The town itself owns 3,280 of the drains on its map. The others belong to the county, the State, neighbouring towns and private owners.
facts.source: Municipality of Princeton, stormwater inlet layer, snapshot of 2026-09-11

facts.text: 2,898 drains in town carry the grate the State calls bicycle safe.
facts.source: Municipality of Princeton, stormwater inlet layer, snapshot of 2026-09-11

facts.text: The town inspected 3,329 drains between June 2023 and June 2024.
facts.source: Municipality of Princeton, stormwater inlet layer, snapshot of 2026-09-11

facts.text: Drains like company. 52 of every hundred drains in town have another drain within ten metres.
facts.source: Municipality of Princeton, stormwater inlet layer, snapshot of 2026-09-11

facts.text: Princeton's Adopt a Drain volunteers check their drain every couple of weeks, before and after a storm.
facts.source: Municipality of Princeton, Adopt a Drain flyer, princetonnj.gov/adoptadrain

facts.text: A clear drain helps prevent flooding on the road and keeps the waterways clean.
facts.source: Municipality of Princeton, Adopt a Drain flyer, princetonnj.gov/adoptadrain
